cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/tmp/bench3.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *
from planning import solve
from common import validate
import networkx as nx
from bench2 import build, nx_graph
for nreq,noff,per in ((2048,4096,32),):
    job=build(nreq,noff,per)
    context=validate(job)
    active={r['id']:True for r in context['requests'].values()}
    t=time.time(); plan=solve(context,active); mine=time.time()-t
    G=nx_graph(context,active)
    t=time.time()
    flow=nx.max_flow_min_cost(G,'S','T')
    value=nx.maximum_flow_value(G,'S','T'); cost=nx.cost_of_flow(G,flow)
    nxt=time.time()-t
    print('nreq=%d noff=%d mine=(%d,%d) in %.2fs  nx=(%d,%d) in %.2fs'%(nreq,noff,plan['resolved'],plan['cost'],mine,value,cost,nxt))
PYEOF
sed -i 's/^for nreq,noff,per in ((256,512,32),(1024,2048,32)):/if __name__=="__main__":\n  for nreq,noff,per in ((256,512,32),(1024,2048,32)):/' /workspace/tmp/bench2.py
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
# indent the body of the for loop in bench2
path='/workspace/tmp/bench2.py'
lines=open(path).read().split('\n')
out=[];inside=False
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('  for nreq,noff,per in'):
        inside=True; out.append(line); continue
    if inside and line.strip() and not line.startswith('    '):
        out.append('    '+line)
    else:
        out.append(line)
open(path,'w').write('\n'.join(out))
PYEOF
